manifest.name: @ruqinhu/dsh-weixin-link
manifest.description: Weixin iLink channel for DeepSeek Harness: send, receive, and verify delivery
manifest.author: ruqinhu

bundle.text:
# @ruqinhu/dsh-weixin-link bundle patch.
#
# `name` is the package name exactly as resolvable from the profile, matching how
# the official bundles address their rows. A bare `weixin-link` would not resolve.
#
# The token is not configured here: it lives in the DSH credential store and is
# referenced by environment-variable name, so this file never carries a secret.
- insert:
    - id: weixin-link
      name: '@ruqinhu/dsh-weixin-link'
      config:
        tokenEnv: WEIXIN_BOT_TOKEN
        accountIdEnv: WEIXIN_BOT_ACCOUNT_ID
        baseUrl: 'https://ilinkai.weixin.qq.com'
        dataDir: '~/.dsh/weixin-link'
        poll: true
        pollTimeoutMs: 40000
        defaultUserId: ''
        echoOwnMessages: false

readme.text:
English | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

The Weixin (iLink) channel for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):
receives messages, and delivers turn results without the model having to remember to
send them.

| Constraint | Consequence |
| --- | --- |
| Every send must carry a `context_token` | a token can only come from an inbound message |
| No token can be minted | a quiet night parks the 07:00 report until the owner speaks |
| A fallback channel would hide failure | no fallback; parked text is replayed, never rerouted |
| Over-long payloads can return a message id and still not arrive | the 2,200-char cap is enforced in code, not trusted to the model |

| `source.kind` | Origin | Delivered |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `schedule` | cron task | ✅ |
| `weixin-link` | owner messaged from Weixin | ✅ |
| `user` | typed in terminal / web UI | ❌ answer already on screen |
| `runtime-context` / `skill-catalog` / `time-context` | injected context | ❌ not speech |
| `compact-checkpoint` / `provider` / `fallback` | compaction, title generation | ❌ internal noise |

Only the **first** user message names the origin: every turn is followed by injected
context, so the last one would classify every turn as context and deliver nothing.

| Problem | Decision | Rejected alternative | Cost paid |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Who delivers | the channel subscribes to `session/event` and sends on `turn/end` | telling the model "you must call `weixin_push`" — it answered in-session and delivered nothing, pushed meta-commentary, and shipped errors as reports | the model cannot choose silence, except via `[SILENT]` |
| Duplicate sends | identical text within 10 min counts as delivered; a manual `weixin_push` stands auto-delivery down | an LLM "is this worth it" gate: a round trip per message, and a silent "don't send" is indistinguishable from a crash | duplicates outside the window still go out |
| Empty turns | `本次无产出（timestamp）` | silence: "ran and failed" looks like "never ran" | one message that may say nothing |
| Failed turns | `⚠️ 回合未完成（reason，timestamp）：本次没有可投递的内容。`, at most one per session per hour | sending the partial text: a fragment reads like an answer; skipping: a crashed 07:00 report looks like a day with no schedule | the hourly floor is in memory, so a restart can add one |
| Images | downloaded from `…/c2c/download?encrypted_query_param=…`, decrypted with **AES-128-ECB**, saved to `inbox/`, and the messa

| Class | Action | Why not the alternative |
| --- | --- | --- |
| stale token | park, do not retry | only a new inbound can mint a token |
| rate limited | back off 30/60/120 s, then park | dropping after the ladder looks like "never scheduled" |
| other | one immediate retry, then give up | more retries turn a blip into a queue stall |
| no `context_token` at all (auto-delivery) | drop, do not park | replaying a week-old report is worse than dropping it |
| replayed entry fails | keep it, never re-park | a second file for the same text means every copy is sent |

| Item | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Unit tests | 248 across 21 files; `tsc --noEmit` clean |
| Delivery round trip | inbound 10:00:04 → turn completed 10:00:24 → `ok msgid=7523202391886746000` in the same second |
| Watchdog | heartbeat advances every round, `restarts: 0` across a 14-hour run |
| Receipts | one JSONL line per attempt, keyed by the operator's local day |

**5.1 An outage, as the trace recorded it.** Quota exhaustion (`429 AccountQuotaExceeded`),
two consecutive builds on the same channel:

| Time (UTC) | Build | Behaviour |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 10:40:29 | old | `skip … turn=304 reason=not-completed` |
| 10:42:31 | old | `skip … turn=305 reason=not-completed` |
| 10:44:34 | old | `skip … turn=306 reason=not-completed` |
| 10:46:33 | new | `send … turn=307 kind=failure len=44` → `ok msgid=7522972414050248000` |
| 10:46+ | new | further notices held back: `skip … reason=failure-notice-rate-limited` |
Four minutes of silence became one line on the phone saying the run did not finish.

| Question | Current state |
| --- | --- |
| Token refresh | cannot be done by the plugin; ~12 h without an inbound message parks sends |
| Recipients | one poll loop, one recipient; multi-account needs a routing layer |
| Replay concurrency | serial; per-entry locking would be needed |
| Failure-notice floor | in memory; persisting costs a write per failure |
| Media / rich cards | none — text is the only payload whose failure is observable here |
| Watchdog false positives | a debugger pause or long GC looks like a stall; restart is harmless but recorded |
| Outbox validation | none at write time; bad entries are skipped on read and logged |

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `0.2.2-rc.1` (peer dependencies pinned) |
| Runtime | Node 22+, no native modules |
| Required services | `tools`, `credentials`, `sessionController`; `agents` optional |
| Payload | text out; inbound text, images, files and voice |
| Voice transcription | needs `python3` + `faster_whisper` + `pilk` on the host; `sttCommand` overrides the helper |

```bash
dsh plugin add @ruqinhu/dsh-weixin-link
```

The token is read through the DSH credential store (`ctx.credentials.resolve()`), not
`process.env`: the store already layers `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` → environment →
project/user `.env`, and reading the environment directly would shadow it.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tokenEnv` | `WEIXIN_BOT_TOKEN` | credential name for the bot token |
| `accountIdEnv` | `WEIXIN_BOT_ACCOUNT_ID` | credential name for the account id |
| `baseUrl` | `https://ilinkai.weixin.qq.com` | iLink endpoint |
| `dataDir` | `~/.dsh/weixin-link` | tokens, outbox, receipts, trace |
| `poll` | `true` | run the inbound long-poll loop |
| `pollTimeoutMs` | `40000` | client budget; must exceed the server's 35 s hold |
| `defaultUserId` | `""` | recipient; empty = most recent inbound sender |
| `echoOwnMessages` | `false` | surface the bot's own messages as inbound |
| `sessionId` | `""` | session inbound is routed to, resumed when cold |
| `replayIntervalMs` | `300000` | outbox retry interval, own timer |
| `dedupeWindowMs` | `600000` | identical texts inside this window count as delivered |
| `notifyTurnFailures` | `true` | announce a turn that ended without completing |
| `watchdogIntervalMs` | `60000` | liveness check interval; `0` disables |
| `enableStt` | `true` | transcribe inbound voice locally; off keeps the file only |
| `sttCommand` | `""` | override the bundled helper; `{file}` is substituted |
| `sttTimeoutMs` | `90000

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `weixin_push` | send now; parks automatically when it cannot deliver |
| `weixin_status` | login state, token age, last delivery, outbox depth, poll liveness |

| File | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `receipts/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl` | one line per send attempt, keyed by the +08:00 day |
| `delivery-trace.log` | one line per turn decision, **including skips and why** |
| `outbox/` | parked messages awaiting a token |
| `state/heartbeat.json` | last attempt/success, failures, inbound count, restarts |
| `inbound-media.log` | one line per inbound non-text message: item types, field **names**/skeleton, and the image save outcome (no URLs, keys or bytes) |
| `inbox/` | inbound images, files and voice, named `<messageId>-<kind><n>.<ext>`, mode 0600 |

```
send session=... turn=12 kind=turn len=63
ok   session=... turn=12 msgid=7521135910923441000
skip session=... turn=13 reason=source-not-deliverable
skip session=... turn=14 reason=duplicate

| Situation | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| session configured, cold start | resume via `sessionController.resolveAgent()` (bare `Agent`, `{ agent }`, or `{ error }` — all three handled) |
| no session configured | route to the first live root agent |
| no agent at all | token cache still refreshed; that is what unblocks delivery |

`sessionController` must be in `static inject`: cordis **throws** on an undeclared
service rather than returning `undefined`, and a `try/catch` turns that into
"messages arrive but nothing ever answers".
[MIT](LICENSE)

Every version bump must produce a release; the tag alone is not enough. 0.4.3–0.6.4 shipped without one, so the server ran tarballs that GitHub never had.

```bash
node scripts/release.mjs --name "vX.Y.Z - summary" --notes notes.md
```

The script builds and packs when the tarball is missing, creates the tag and release, uploads the `.tgz`, and pushes the tag. An existing release of the same tag gets the asset attached instead of a second release. It reads `GH_TOKEN` / `GITHUB_TOKEN`, falling back to the `github.com` entry in `~/.git-credentials` (`credential.helper=store`).

[English](README.md) | 中文

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的微信 iLink 通道：
收消息，并且不依赖模型记得就把回合结果投递出去。

| 约束 | 后果 |
| --- | --- |
| 每次发送都必须带 `context_token` | token 只能来自入站消息 |
| token 无法生成 | 安静的夜晚意味着 07:00 早报被暂存，直到 owner 开口 |
| 保底通道会掩盖失败 | 不做保底；暂存的文本只重放，不改道 |
| 超长载荷可能返回 message id 却没送达 | 2,200 字符上限在代码里强制，不依赖模型遵守 |

| `source.kind` | 来源 | 投递 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `schedule` | 定时任务 | ✅ |
| `weixin-link` | 用户在微信发起 | ✅ |
| `user` | 终端 / Web 输入 | ❌ 屏幕上已经有了 |
| `runtime-context` / `skill-catalog` / `time-context` | 注入的上下文 | ❌ 不是对话 |
| `compact-checkpoint` / `provider` / `fallback` | 压缩、标题生成 | ❌ 内部噪音 |

只认**第一条** user 消息：每个回合后面都跟着注入的上下文，取最后一条会把所有回合判成上下文，
结果一条都不投。

| 问题 | 决定 | 否决的替代 | 代价 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 谁来投递 | 通道订阅 `session/event`，在 `turn/end` 自己发 | 让模型「必须调用 weixin_push」：它会在会话里回答而不投递、发元叙述、把错误当报告发 | 模型无法决定沉默，除非 `[SILENT]` |
| 重复发送 | 十分钟内同文本算已投递；已手动 `weixin_push` 则自动投递让位 | LLM 判定「值不值得打扰」：每条多一次往返，且「别发」与崩溃无法区分 | 窗口之外的重复仍会发 |
| 空回合 | 发 `本次无产出（时间戳）` | 静默：「跑了但挂了」和「根本没跑」无法区分 | 有时是一句废话 |
| 失败回合 | `⚠️ 回合未完成（原因，时间戳）：本次没有可投递的内容。`，每会话每小时最多一条 | 发半截正文：碎片读起来像答案；静默：崩掉的早报像没排任务 | 每小时下限存在内存，重启会多一条 |
| 图片 | 从 `…/c2c/download?encrypted_query_param=…` 下载，**AES-128-ECB** 解密，存进 `inbox/`，消息里给出文件路径供 `read_image` 读取 | 静默丢弃：2026-11-04 用户发了两次图片，agent 和日志都没看见，最后说「不改了就这样吧」 | 每份附件一次下载（在后台任务里），解密失败降级成占位文本 |
| 其他媒体 | 折成一条模型能处理的占位文本（`（收到 1 个文件…）`），并把线上字段骨架追加进 `inbound-media.log` | 假装读过语音或文件：模型会对着没人读过的内容作答 | 内容仍未读取 —— 占位文本如实说明 |
| 文件 | 下载、解密、存进 `inbox/`，消息里给出路径供 `read` 或 `bash` 读取 | 直接丢弃：用户发来的文档对 agent 等于不存在 | 识别不出类型时存成 `.bin`，不猜格式 |
| 语音 | 下载后走 silk → 24 kHz wav（`pilk`）→ faster-whisper `base` int8，参数同官方（`beam_size 5`、`condition_on_previous_text False`、VAD 默认开且最短静音 500 ms、`no_speech_threshold 0.6`、`log_prob_threshold -1`），转写文本直接作为用户消息 | 把音频喂给模型：本部署 `input_audio` 返回 422，转写是唯一通路 | 1.9 GB 机器上每条 5–10 秒；转写失败降级成「已保存」而不是静默 |
| 收发解耦 | 重放独立定时器 + 单飞；bootstrap 不 await | 在轮询里

| 类别 | 动作 | 为什么不换一种 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| token 失效 | 暂存，不重试 | 只有新的入站消息能生成 token |
| 被限流 | 退避 30/60/120 秒，之后暂存 | 退避完就丢，看起来和「从未被调度」一样 |
| 其他 | 立即重试一次，再失败就放弃 | 更多重试会把抖动变成队列停摆 |
| 完全没有 token（自动投递） | 丢弃，不暂存 | 重放一周前的报告比丢掉更糟 |
| 重放条目失败 | 保留，绝不二次暂存 | 同一段文本两个文件 = 恢复后每条都发 |

| 项 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 单测 | 248 个、21 个文件；`tsc --noEmit` 干净 |
| 投递往返 | 入站 10:00:04 → 回合 10:00:24 完成 → 同一秒 `ok msgid=7523202391886746000` |
| Watchdog | 心跳逐轮前进，连续运行 14 小时 `restarts: 0` |
| 收据 | 每次尝试一行 JSONL，按操作者本地日归档 |

**5.1 一次故障，trace 是这么记的。** 配额耗尽（`429 AccountQuotaExceeded`），同一通道的两个版本：

| 时间（UTC） | 版本 | 行为 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 10:40:29 | 旧 | `skip … turn=304 reason=not-completed` |
| 10:42:31 | 旧 | `skip … turn=305 reason=not-completed` |
| 10:44:34 | 旧 | `skip … turn=306 reason=not-completed` |
| 10:46:33 | 新 | `send … turn=307 kind=failure len=44` → `ok msgid=7522972414050248000` |
| 10:46 之后 | 新 | 后续通知被限流：`skip … reason=failure-notice-rate-limited` |

四分钟的沉默，变成手机上的一行字：这一轮没跑完。

| 问题 | 现状 |
| --- | --- |
| token 刷新 | 插件做不到；约 12 小时没有入站消息，发送就会被暂存 |
| 收件人 | 单轮询、单收件人；多账号需要一层路由 |
| 重放并发 | 串行；并发需要按条目的锁 |
| 失败通知下限 | 存在内存；持久化要为每次失败写一次文件 |
| 图片 / 富卡片 | 无 —— 只有文本的失败在这里是可观测的 |
| Watchdog 误判 | 调试器停顿或长 GC 看起来像停摆；重启无害但会被记录 |
| outbox 校验 | 写入时无校验；坏条目读取时跳过并记日志 |

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `0.2.2-rc.1`（peer 依赖按此钉住） |
| 运行时 | Node 22+，无原生模块 |
| 必需服务 | `tools`、`credentials`、`sessionController`；`agents` 可选 |
| 载荷 | 出站纯文本；入站文本、图片、文件、语音 |
| 语音转写 | 需要主机上有 `python3` + `faster_whisper` + `pilk`；`sttCommand` 可替换 |

dsh plugin add @ruqinhu/dsh-weixin-link
```

token 通过 DSH 凭据库读取（`ctx.credentials.resolve()`），不读 `process.env`：凭据库已按
`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` → 环境变量 → 项目/用户 `.env` 分层解析，直读环境变量会遮蔽它。

| 键 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tokenEnv` | `WEIXIN_BOT_TOKEN` | bot token 的凭据名 |
| `accountIdEnv` | `WEIXIN_BOT_ACCOUNT_ID` | 账号 id 的凭据名 |
| `baseUrl` | `https://ilinkai.weixin.qq.com` | iLink 端点 |
| `dataDir` | `~/.dsh/weixin-link` | token、outbox、收据、trace |
| `poll` | `true` | 是否跑入站长轮询 |
| `pollTimeoutMs` | `40000` | 客户端预算，必须大于服务端 35 秒挂起 |
| `defaultUserId` | `""` | 收件人；空 = 最近一次入站发送者 |
| `echoOwnMessages` | `false` | 是否把 bot 自己的消息当作入站 |
| `sessionId` | `""` | 入站投递到的会话，冷启动时恢复 |
| `replayIntervalMs` | `300000` | outbox 重试间隔，独立定时器 |
| `dedupeWindowMs` | `600000` | 窗口内相同文本算已投递 |
| `notifyTurnFailures` | `true` | 是否通报未正常结束的回合 |
| `watchdogIntervalMs` | `60000` | 存活检查间隔；`0` 关闭 |
| `enableStt` | `true` | 是否本地转写入站语音；关闭则只保存文件 |
| `sttCommand` | `""` | 覆盖内置转写命令；`{file}` 会被替换 |
| `sttTimeoutMs` | `90000` | 单条转写超时 |
| `sttPrompt` | 简体中文提示 | 初始提示；不设时 `base` 会输出繁体 |

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `weixin_push` | 立即发送；发不出去时自动暂存 |
| `weixin_status` | 登录态、token 年龄、最近投递、积压深度、轮询存活 |

| 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `receipts/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl` | 每次发送尝试一行，按 +08:00 本地日归档 |
| `delivery-trace.log` | 每个回合的判定一行，**含跳过与原因** |
| `outbox/` | 等 token 的暂存消息 |
| `state/heartbeat.json` | 上次尝试/成功、失败数、入站数、重启数 |
| `inbound-media.log` | 每条非文本入站一行：item 类型、字段名与骨架、图片保存结果（不含 URL、密钥或字节） |
| `inbox/` | 入站图片、文件与语音，命名 `<messageId>-<kind><n>.<ext>`，权限 0600 |

```
send session=... turn=12 kind=turn len=63
ok   session=... turn=12 msgid=7521135910923441000
skip session=... turn=13 reason=source-not-deliverable
skip session=... turn=14 reason=duplicate

| 情形 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 配了 session、冷启动 | 用 `sessionController.resolveAgent()` 恢复（裸 `Agent`、`{ agent }`、`{ error }` 三种都要认） |
| 没配 session | 投给第一个活的根 agent |
| 完全没有 agent | token 缓存照常刷新 —— 那才是解锁投递的关键 |

`sessionController` 必须写进 `static inject`：cordis 对未声明的服务**抛异常**而不是返回
`undefined`，被 `try/catch` 吞掉就表现为「消息收到了但没人回」。
[MIT](LICENSE)

每次版本号变化都必须打 Release，只有 tag 不够。0.4.3–0.6.4 就是这么丢的：服务器上跑的是本地 tgz，GitHub 上根本没有对应产物。

```bash
node scripts/release.mjs --name "vX.Y.Z - 摘要" --notes notes.md
```

脚本会：tgz 缺失时自动 build+pack → 建 tag 与 release → 上传 `.tgz` → 推送 tag。同名 release 已存在时只补资产，不重复创建。token 优先取 `GH_TOKEN` / `GITHUB_TOKEN`，否则读 `~/.git-credentials` 里的 github.com 条目（`credential.helper=store`）。
